_comment: Copy to credentials.json and fill in. This file holds real portal
credentials and must never be committed.
login_origins is not optional bookkeeping: it is the set of places a run
using this credential is allowed to visit, on top of the service's own
origin. Growth delegates its sign-in to UAE Pass on another host, so that
host has to be listed here. It is configured next to the credential, by
whoever administers this machine, and deliberately NOT taken from the task
envelope -- otherwise a task could name whatever host it liked and the
agent would type a password into it.
password is optional. UAE Pass signs in on the Emirates ID alone (as the
username) and then approves on the mobile app, so growth_uae_pass needs no
password -- leave it out. Only a credential with a username is used.
